method: Qwen img2img conditioned on placed foreground composite, followed by deterministic original-foreground alpha replacement
mask_convention: white = original foreground protected; black = generated background visible
limitations: QwenImage21Pipeline does not accept a mask_image in this installed version; model_raw.png is a full-image regeneration, not masked diffusion.
Original foreground pixels are restored after generation, while semitransparent antialiased edges blend with the generated image.
Model-generated subjects can potentially leak outside the protected mask, creating ghosts; no pixel or latent lock exists inside the model.
Visible contact-shadow and cutout-edge improvements in this single attempt are modest.
